svg.aria-label: Four animals drawn in a 2 by 2 grid. I, top left, a rabbit crouching and facing left, its long ears laid back, with eye, nose, whiskers, forepaws under the chest, the hind leg folded under the body with the long hind foot along the ground, and a small round tail. II, top right, a crocodile with its long snout pointing up to the upper left and its jaws a little open, showing teeth, a raised eye, a heavy body covered in rows of plates, four short splayed legs with claws, and a thick tail with a ridged crest curving round at the right. III, bottom left, a squat warty toad sitting and facing left, with a raised eye, a large gland behind the eye, stout front legs with fingers and folded hind legs with webbed toes. IV, bottom right, a tilapia-like fish facing right, with a long dorsal fin, spiny in front and soft behind, a square-cut tail fin, pectoral, pelvic and anal fins, a gill cover, a lateral line, an eye and overlapping scales
